scientific_integrity: Self-contained all-size proof by rectangular singular-value decomposition and reverse odd-moment recovery. Finite enumerations corroborate but do not certify an infinite assertion. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Real symmetric mutual-zero-product relation on nonzero elements of regular combinatorial Rees 0-semigroups; not the ordinary loopless commuting graph, not arbitrary nontrivial maximal subgroups. The binary adjacency criterion is antecedent literature; novelty is evaluated for the spectral reduction and its consequences. Historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Singular-value rigidity of annihilation spectra in combinatorial Rees semigroups
